brand.name: Vaulta™
brand.description: The Financial Operating System of the ANCR ecosystem
brand.aesthetic: Bloomberg Terminal + Stripe Dashboard + Ramp + Linear + Apple Wallet. Obsidian black canvas with glassmorphism cards, electric blue → violet → orange gradient accents used sparingly for premium moments. Editorial typography scale. Data-dense but breathing. Every screen must feel executive, institutional, and enterprise-grade.

headings.usage: H1-H4, KPI values, major section headers, editorial moments

body.usage: Data tables, UI labels, body text, financial details

layouts.navigation: Left ecosystem navigation (same as every ANCR module), fixed 240px-280px sidebar. Solid obsidian base (#050505) to anchor the UI. ANCR logo positioned at the bottom of the sidebar. User will provide Vaulta logo for the top.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Use CSS Grid with varying spans (col-span-1 for summaries, col-span-2 or 3 for primary charts). Data-dense but breathable with p-6 or p-8 inside containers.
layouts.cards: Glassmorphism cards with `backdrop-blur-xl`, `bg-white/[0.02]`, `border border-white/10`. Inside padding must be generous (p-6). DO NOT USE FULL TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS.
layouts.tables: Executive data tables. Minimalist, left-aligned, border-b only for rows (`border-white/10`), hover states lift slightly with `bg-white/[0.04]`.
layouts.spacing_scale: p-2, p-4, p-6 (inner cards), p-8 (sections), p-12, p-16. Use generous padding inside borders.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, modal overlays, toasts, and KPI cards. Formula: `bg-white/[0.03] backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/[0.08]`. Never use 100% transparent backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use subtle colored drop shadows for accent elements (e.g., `drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)]` on electric blue elements).
visual_enhancers.gradients: Apply the Electric Blue -> Violet -> Orange gradient sparingly. Use it for premium moments: primary CTA borders, progress bars, active state lines, or subtle glowing orbs in the background. Avoid full background gradients.
visual_enhancers.no_emojis: CRITICAL: Do not use emojis anywhere in the application. Use crisp, premium SVGs from Phosphor Icons or Lucide.

motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (`-translate-y-1`), borders become slightly more opaque, subtle ambient shadow increases.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth fade in, slight upward translation (`translate-y-4` to `translate-y-0`) for lists and cards in a staggered fashion.
motion.buttons: Gradient-trimmed buttons have a glowing active state. Use `transition-[transform,opacity,box-shadow] duration-300 ease-in-out` (avoid transition-all).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular with 1px border. Primary CTA uses the gradient trim or solid electric blue text with a glowing hover. No solid colored backgrounds except for critical actions.
components.kpi_tiles: Display Net Worth, Cash Available, etc. Label on top (uppercase, tracking wide), large numbers in Cabinet Grotesk, small sparkline or trend indicator below. Backdrop-blur-xl with obsidian surface.
components.sidebar: Left fixed layout. Darker than main content (`#050505`). Highlight active route with a thin gradient left border or subtle glass background.
components.charts: Translucent fills, thin bright lines. Recharts or Shadcn charts with colors mapped to the accent palette (Electric Blue, Violet, Orange).

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA. Use off-white (#e5e7eb) for primary text instead of pure white to reduce eye strain. Secondary text must have sufficient contrast against #0A0A0A.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on inputs (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-black`).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="sidebar-nav-dashboard"`).

image_urls.description: Close-up of cracked glass pieces on a black surface. Use sparingly as a masked background texture in premium empty states, auth screen, or loading screens.
A dark room with clear glass wall panel. Can be used as a low-opacity background for the Vault or Settings modules to add depth.
Eerie silhouettes in a foggy alleyway, captured at night. Can be used for cinematic, moody login/auth backgrounds.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) or lucide-react. Phosphor Icons preferred for dense dashboards. DO NOT USE EMOJIS.
media.logos: Use official Vaulta logo throughout (user will provide). ANCR logo at the bottom of the sidebar.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make this look like an executive, professional financial operating system, similar to Bloomberg Terminal or Ramp.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use dark colors independently as solid background variants (Obsidian Black).
DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Target specific properties like `transform`, `opacity`, `color`.
DO NOT center align the app container. Keep it left-aligned, standard web app layout.
DO NOT use emojis anywhere in the UI. Use high-quality SVGs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).

CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, dropdowns, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is strictly forbidden. Use `bg-black/90` or solid.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` (kebab-case, role-based).
You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files.
